paths.naming: Win32 load_config/save_config call create_local_path("pc8801ma.ini"). [Control] persists BootMode, CPUType, DipSwitch, OptionSwitch, JoystickType, disk timing/CRC and sound settings; [RecentFiles] persists floppy, tape and compact-disc paths; [Input] persists JoyButtonsEx1_1..JoyButtonsEx8_16 and JoyToKey settings.

The WinMM backend enumerates joystick IDs 0..3 at runtime and uses JoyButtonsEx values encoded as (joystick_index << 5) | direction/button/axis/POV bit. JoyToKeyButtons negative values encode Windows virtual keys; UseJoyToKey, JoyToKeyType and JoyToKeyNumPad5 are persisted in [Input]. The PC-8801MA [Control] JoystickType selects emulated joystick (0) or mouse (1). keycode.cfg is an optional 256-byte VK-to-DIK table, not a stable controller identity.

paths.path: The user-selected floppy, binary-only tape and optional CD image files; no ePC-8801MA game-save sidecar is written by the reviewed VM.
paths.naming: Floppy and CD persistence stays inside the attached image. TAPE_BINARY_ONLY means tape recording/playback uses the selected host file. [RecentFiles] stores paths, but the emulator does not translate them into a separate save directory.

paths.naming: Ten Win32 menu slots call state_file_path(n), formatting <CONFIG_NAME>.sta<n>. The stream includes the common outer/config state and the complete PC-8801MA device graph; it is version/build-bound (outer state version 3, config-state version 8) rather than a portable interchange format.

paths.path: <directory containing pc8801ma.exe>\N88.ROM (or PC88.ROM aggregate) and KANJI1.ROM for the PC-8801MA baseline; optional N88_0.ROM..N88_3.ROM split expansion, N80.ROM, E1.ROM..E8.ROM disk-driver ROMs, KANJI2.ROM, JISYO.ROM and CDBIOS.ROM.
paths.naming: The MA source build loads the PC-8801 ROM set from the executable directory. N88.ROM or the split N88_0..N88_3 files provide the N88 system/expansion ROMs; KANJI1.ROM provides the Kanji ROM. N80.ROM is for N-BASIC mode, E1..E8 are optional DiskDrv ROMs, JISYO.ROM is the dictionary, and CDBIOS.ROM is read when the CD-ROM option is enabled. The MA build does not define SUPPORT_PC88_16BIT, so the PC-8801-16_I86.ROM/PC-8801-16_Z80.ROM pair listed for older family variants is not part of this target's load path. No canonical checksums are published for user-supplied ROMs.

paths.path: No cryptographic or firmware-key file is used by ePC-8801MA.
paths.naming: keycode.cfg is an input scan-code conversion table and belongs to the input disposition; ROMs are firmware assets, not decryption keys.

windows.notes: The official x64 artifact is a PE32+ Windows executable. Lunchbox has no verified native controller writer for this Windows-only target; it must not modify a user's pc8801ma.ini or keycode.cfg.

linux.reason: The official distribution provides Windows Win32/x64 ePC binaries and source with a Win32 frontend, but no verified native Linux ePC-8801MA package.

linux-flatpak.reason: No official ePC-8801MA Flatpak package or manifest is published by the Common Source Code Project.

macos.reason: The official distribution provides Windows Win32/x64 ePC binaries and no verified native macOS ePC-8801MA package.
